props.gloss_en: one said: if a stone and grasses are before him, he wipes with the stone and does not wipe with the grasses
and one said: he wipes with the grasses and does not wipe with the stone
the baraita: one who wipes with something that fire takes hold of -- his lower teeth fall out
one said: one who needs to relieve himself and does not -- an evil spirit takes hold of him
and one said: a spirit of filth takes hold of him
the baraita: one who needs to relieve himself and eats -- that is the beginning of the spirit of filth
...is like an oven that was heated on top of its ashes
Rav Chisda: one who needs to relieve himself and cannot should stand and sit, stand and sit
Rav Chanan of Nehardea: he should move off to the sides
Rav Hamnuna: he should touch that place with a stone
the Rabbis: he should divert his mind
Rav Ashi: 'divert his mind' means divert it from other matters

the baraita: one who enters a fixed meal walks, relieves himself, and enters and sits in his place
